title: File Upload
summary: A drop area that opens the platform file dialog or takes dropped files, filtered by accept, and lists each file with its upload progress, an error with a retry, and removal. The host uploads; the component shows the state the host sets.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

link-text.description: Empty: the text of the page's language ("Click to upload" in English).

formats.description: Formats line shown under the action. When not set it is derived from accept, and is empty when neither is given: the component names no formats it cannot know.

supporting-text.description: Supporting line; falls back to formats.

items.description: The files and their uploads, written by the host: each entry's state (process, done, error) and progress 0-100 is its stream (§10.8)

removeItem.summary: Remove the item at this index from the list; an index outside the list does nothing. Returns the element.

clear.summary: Empty the list. Returns the element.

getItems.summary: The listed files as item objects.

setItems.summary: Replace the list with these items (name, fileSize, state, progress, errorMessage). Returns the element.

setState.summary: Apply several inputs at once (size, icon, linkText, text, formats, supportingText, accept, multiple, disabled, items). Returns the element.

onFileAdd.summary: Listen for sf-file-upload:file-add; handler receives the event. Returns the element.

onFileError.summary: Listen for sf-file-upload:file-error; handler receives the event. Returns the element.

onFileComplete.summary: Listen for sf-file-upload:file-complete; handler receives the event. Returns the element.

onFileRemove.summary: Listen for sf-file-upload:remove; handler receives the event. Returns the element.

onFileRetry.summary: Listen for sf-file-upload:retry; handler receives the event. Returns the element.

onComplete.summary: Listen for sf-file-upload:complete; handler receives the event. Returns the element.

change.summary: Files were chosen: the native event from the inner file input for a pick, and a CustomEvent from the area for a drop (detail files and source 'drop'), so a form hears of both.

sf-file-upload-attach.summary: Files were selected for upload. Standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 name (vocabulary 1.1.5 §9.1); sf-file-upload:select follows it with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

sf-file-upload-attached.summary: A file entered the list. Standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 name (vocabulary 1.1.5 §9.1); sf-file-upload:file-add follows it with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

item.description: name, fileName, fileSize, state (process, done, error), progress, errorMessage

sf-file-upload-detach.summary: A file was removed from the list. Standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 name (vocabulary 1.1.5 §9.1); sf-file-upload:remove follows it with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

item.description: name, fileName, fileSize, state (process, done, error), progress, errorMessage

sf-file-upload-rejected.summary: Dropped files the accept list does not name were left out, as the platform dialog would not have offered them. Standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 name (vocabulary 1.1.5 §9.1); sf-file-upload:reject follows it with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

sf-file-upload-retry.summary: A failed file was retried. Standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 name (vocabulary 1.1.5 §9.1); sf-file-upload:retry follows it with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

item.description: name, fileName, fileSize, state (process, done, error), progress, errorMessage

sf-file-upload-begun.summary: An entry entered process -- chosen, dropped or retried: its upload stream began (standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 §10.8, vocabulary 1.1.5 §5.2).

sf-file-upload-chunk.summary: The host moved an entry's progress while it is in process: {id, done, total} with total 100 (§10.8).

sf-file-upload-completed.summary: A file finished uploading. Standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 name (vocabulary 1.1.5 §9.1); sf-file-upload:file-complete follows it with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

item.description: name, fileName, fileSize, state (process, done, error), progress, errorMessage

sf-file-upload-failed.summary: A file failed. Standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 name (vocabulary 1.1.5 §9.1); sf-file-upload:file-error follows it with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

item.description: name, fileName, fileSize, state (process, done, error), progress, errorMessage

sf-file-upload-cancelled.summary: An entry left while in process -- removed by the person or by the host: its stream ended without completing (§10.8).

sf-file-upload-finished.summary: Every file finished. Standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8 name (vocabulary 1.1.5 §9.1); sf-file-upload:complete follows it with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

sf-file-upload:complete.summary: Every file finished. Legacy name: sent after sf-file-upload-finished with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

sf-file-upload:file-add.summary: A file entered the list. Legacy name: sent after sf-file-upload-attached with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

item.description: name, fileName, fileSize, state (process, done, error), progress, errorMessage

sf-file-upload:file-complete.summary: A file finished uploading. Legacy name: sent after sf-file-upload-completed with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

item.description: name, fileName, fileSize, state (process, done, error), progress, errorMessage

sf-file-upload:file-error.summary: A file failed. Legacy name: sent after sf-file-upload-failed with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

item.description: name, fileName, fileSize, state (process, done, error), progress, errorMessage

sf-file-upload:reject.summary: Dropped files the accept list does not name were left out, as the platform dialog would not have offered them. Legacy name: sent after sf-file-upload-rejected with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

sf-file-upload:remove.summary: A file was removed from the list. Legacy name: sent after sf-file-upload-detach with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

item.description: name, fileName, fileSize, state (process, done, error), progress, errorMessage

sf-file-upload:retry.summary: A failed file was retried. Legacy name: sent after sf-file-upload-retry with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

item.description: name, fileName, fileSize, state (process, done, error), progress, errorMessage

sf-file-upload:select.summary: Files were selected for upload. Legacy name: sent after sf-file-upload-attach with the same detail until 2026-12-01 (aliases.json).

accessibility.focus: The enabled drop zone is the picker focus owner; nested file actions retain native activation. Use focus-visible and a real forced-colors outline. Disabled controls leave the tab order; re-enabling restores authored tabindex.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-file-upload for local file selection and item-state presentation. Consumer code owns transport and server validation. Shared root-class/style/root-style customize the drop zone, not the adjacent file list; cosmetic renders preserve item File objects. afterRender(callback) uses the base registration API.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component
